Rationale.GT1_ModelGeneralization: No compatible transformer model available for testing. The only alternative model (LD2.onnx) uses a CNN architecture that is incompatible with the transformer-specific logit lens implementation. External model downloads failed due to network access issues. The finding cannot be verified on a new model.
Rationale.GT2_DataGeneralization: The three-phase progression finding generalizes to new data. Testing on 3 new chess positions (not in the original dataset) showed: (1) clear entropy reduction through layers indicating policy refinement, (2) the characteristic three-phase pattern with sharp late-layer strengthening (Trial 2: Phase 3 avg 0.64 vs Phase 1-2 avg 0.34), and (3) the solution discovery and forgetting phenomenon where intermediate layers explore different moves before the final solution emerges (Trial 3).
Rationale.GT3_MethodGeneralization: The logit lens method generalizes to similar tasks. Three trials demonstrated successful application: (1) WDL head analysis revealed value estimation relies heavily on late layers, (2) Moves-left head showed progressive estimation patterns across layers, (3) Endgame positions exhibited the same three-phase dynamics as middlegame. The method can analyze multiple output heads and different game phases, demonstrating its applicability beyond the original policy analysis task.
